import { type JSXChildren, type QRL, type QwikIntrinsicElements } from '@builder.io/qwik';
import type { SelectOption, ValueChangeDetails } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface NativeSelectProps extends Omit<QwikIntrinsicElements['select'], 'children' | 'value' | 'size' | 'multiple' | 'onChange$'> {
    options: SelectOption[];
    value?: string;
    defaultValue?: string;
    label?: JSXChildren;
    hint?: JSXChildren;
    error?: JSXChildren;
    invalid?: boolean;
    size?: 'small' | 'medium' | 'large';
    onValueChange$?: QRL<(details: ValueChangeDetails<string>) => void>;
}
export declare const NativeSelect: import("@builder.io/qwik").Component<NativeSelectProps>;
